test_title: PYST 59: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

We were driving home when suddenly a deer runs across the road.

options.text: a deer runs across the road

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the present tense 'runs' is incorrect.
 
• The sentence describes an action that was ongoing in the past when another event occurred suddenly.
 
• Therefore, the verb 'runs' should be in the past tense to match the context of the sentence.
 
• Hence, the correct form of the verb 'runs' should be 'ran'.

Hence, the correct statement is **'*We were driving home when suddenly a deer ran across the road__*__.__**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When describing past events, it is important to maintain consistency in the verb tenses.
 
• In this case, the ongoing action (**'were driving**') sets the scene in the past, and the sudden event **('ran across')** should also be in the past tense.
